title: The BayGMST statistical model
text: Per Barboza et al. (2019, section 2.3), three external forcings used family models : Volcanic forcing (VtV_t): zonal-mean stratospheric aerosol optical depth 550 nm eVolv2k dataset (Toohey Sigl, 2017), covering 500 BCE 1900 CE, area-weighted averaged global annual estimate. Solar forcing (StS_t): total solar irradiance SATIRE-H reconstruction (Vieira et al., 2011), decadal 1940 CE daily thereafter, interpolated annual resolution. Greenhouse-gas forcing (GtG_t): hemispheric-mean atmospheric CO2 mole fraction (ppm) annual resolution (Meinshausen et al., 2017), extended back using ice-core-based compilations PMIP4-CMIP6 past1000 forcing set (Jungclaus et al., 2017). series measure perturbation top atmosphere energy budget, thus expressed Wm−2\mathrm{W\,m^{-2}}, following climate science convention. effect conversion original units (aerosol optical depth VtV_t; mole fraction GtG_t), transform_forcings() implements Gt′=𝚌𝚘𝟸_𝚌𝚘𝚎𝚏×log⁡(Gt/𝚌𝚘𝟸_𝚌𝟶),Vt′=−|𝚟𝚘𝚕_𝚌𝚘𝚎𝚏|(1−e−Vt), G'_t = \texttt{co2\_coef} \times \log(G_t / \texttt{co2\_c0}), \qquad V'_t = -\lvert\texttt{vol\_coef}\rvert \,(1 - e^{-V_t}), co2_coef = 5.35 simplified CO2 radiative forcing coefficient Myhre et al. (1998), adopted throughout IPCC assessment reports; co2_c0 = 280 ppm standard pre-industrial atmospheric CO2 reference concentration; vol_coef = 25 stratospheric aerosol optical depth--forcing scaling factor (Wm−2\mathrm{W\,m^{-2}} per unit optical depth) used IPCC AR5, traced GISS ModelE lineage Hansen et al. (2005).
